placements.why: This envelope's entire content is an observatory instrument calibration report and its verification — nothing in the (empty) supplied strata covers organizational calibration work, and the domain vocabulary here (instrument calibration value, verification against reference plates) is exactly what a Calibration strata category exists to hold going forward.
placements.title: Calibration as a distinct organizational discipline
placements.theme: Instrument calibration and its verification against reference standards is tracked as its own organizational concern, separate from opportunity, product, or proof work.

placements.title: Calibration confidence rests on cross-checked reference verification
placements.theme: An instrument's calibration value is trusted not on its own assertion but because it has been checked against archived reference plates and holds across the full operating range.
placements.why: src-1 states the calibration result, src-2 grounds that result in a verification act against the June reference plates across the full observing band, and src-4 restates the same calibration-plus-verification fact under session footing — together they carry a recurring theme (calibration claims are only as good as their reference-check) that future calibration envelopes for this or other instruments will keep feeding, not a one-time measurement alone.
